entries.name: Stop the running turn
entries.purpose: The per-stream interrupt — cancel just the DISPLAYED stream's in-flight run (also bound to Esc while COMMS is focused), distinct from safety.js's global Alt+H halt.
entries.promise: Hidden while the active stream is idle; shown while it is busy; a click (stopActive) aborts that stream's AbortController + server runId, drops its type-ahead queue, pauses any active goal loop, and keeps the partial reply as an honest stopped card (no forever-RUNNING chip).
entries.notes: AUDITED not perfected: idle half live-proven (#chat-stop hidden=true while idle, handler=stopActive wired, title/aria honest — .uiatlas/world2-evidence/comms-composer-probe.txt, chat-stop-idle), but the busy-shown half + click-interrupt path has NO machine assertion. J2a/b/c drive interrupt truth via the GLOBAL Alt+H E-STOP only, never #chat-stop.click. Coverage gap filed (fp bd391f68 → journey-corps).
